title: Updates to customer notification email
description: The From email address on outbound customer notifications will be fixed to the configured Reply To address for the Customer Experience. If you have a custom From address that differs from your Reply To address, this change will affect how your emails appear to customers. This change also includes a fix to the notifications bug.
